mapper.select: select p.post_id, p.title, p.category, p.content, p.author_id, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.create_time, p.update_time, ifnull(nullif(trim(u.real_name), ''), u.nick_name) as author_name, nullif(trim(mp.community_nickname), '') as author_community_nickname, u.member_department as author_department, u.avatar as author_avatar from qt_forum_post p left join sys_user u on p.author_id = u.user_id left join qt_member_profile mp on mp.user_id = u.user_id where p.post_id = #{postId}
select post_id, author_id from qt_forum_post where post_id = #{postId} for update

select p.post_id, p.title, p.category, p.content, p.author_id, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.create_time, p.update_time, ifnull(nullif(trim(u.real_name), ''), u.nick_name) as author_name, nullif(trim(mp.community_nickname), '') as author_community_nickname, u.member_department as author_department, u.avatar as author_avatar from qt_forum_post p
inner join qt_forum_post_like r on r.post_id = p.post_id inner join qt_forum_post_favorite r on r.post_id = p.post_id
left join sys_user u on p.author_id = u.user_id left join qt_member_profile mp on mp.user_id = u.user_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and p.category = #{category} order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into qt_forum_post (title, category, content, author_id, comment_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{title}, #{category}, #{content}, #{authorId}, 0, now(), now())
